output.reason: I find this convincing because it uses natural controls: P31–P38 stayed on 6.3 and the Zone C tote robots got 6.4, and neither group changed while temps were present for both, so temps can't explain the gap. It also explains why the film did nothing in August, since the stops only started after the firmware upgrade, and a bench test backs this up. The next steps are clear, though the film fix hasn't been tried on the real floor yet.
